Package neqsim.process.mpc

Class HorizonSolver

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.mpc.HorizonSolver
final class HorizonSolver extends Object
Convex step-response planner for a single MPC scan. The independent decisions are MV increments. Each row of the convolution, the absolute MV trajectory and its slew has a scalar convex cost or interval constraint. ADMM splits those rows from the linear trajectory and factors the least-squares matrix once per scan.
